dotplot.def: A graph of a quantitative variable that puts one dot above a number line for each value; repeated values stack up.

stemplot.def: A display of a quantitative variable that splits each value into a stem (its leading digits) and a leaf (its last digit), so every value is kept. It needs a key, such as 7 | 4 stands for 74.

histogram.def: A graph of a quantitative variable that groups values into equal-width bins on a number line, with touching bars whose heights are the counts or relative frequencies in each bin.

cumulative-graph.def: A graph that shows, for each value, the proportion of the data at or below that value (the relative frequencies added up from the left).
